coin.title: Malta 10 Euro "EuroPride" 2023 Silver Prooflike PL69
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RKHQLG5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A one-of-a-kind Malta 10 Euro Silver Prooflike in your collection? PF69 coins are nearly perfect, with superb detail and nearly flawless surfaces. Minor marks are virtually invisible, preserving their brilliance. This is a wonderful choice for any collector! Design The €10 “EuroPride Malta” Silver Prooflike coin is even more cheerful than the issue in coincard. The coin features rainbow coloured detailing on the letters forming the word ‘PRIDE’. The reverse of the coin shows the coat of arms of the Central Bank of Malta and the date 2023.
